text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Friday.
- The Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ) city commission president Zlatko Canjuga, said prior to Friday's telecommunication's council decision: Radio 101 should get a frequency.
- Rape within marriage becomes a crime by the Croatian penal code.
- Following a decision by the pensioners' fund to improve pensions by 10 percent, the lowest possible pension stands at 824 (230DM) kuna and the highest at 3,532 (980DM).
- Experts are being lured to the scarcely populated regions of the country badly in need of demographic rejuvenation, but there are no flats to offer to those people who choose to move there.
- The constituional court has rejected former constitutional court president's suit he has filed against the decision of his dismissal. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
